number.why: HR 0.90 (0.76-1.07) is the EINSTEIN-PE principal safety outcome, defined as major or clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding, which is exactly the served outcome. The registry reports the same HR in the valid-for-safety population. Major bleeding alone (0.49) is correctly not used.

quotes.span: The principal safety outcome was major or clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding.
The principal safety outcome occurred in 10.3% of patients in the rivaroxaban group and 11.4% of those in the standard-therapy group (hazard ratio, 0.90; 95% CI, 0.76 to 1.07; P=0.23).
Confirmed acute symptomatic proximal PE with or without symptomatic DVT
